code:
Policy: CA-Require-MFA-Compliant-Device-Admins
Users: Finance-Admins, Loan-Ops-Admins
Cloud apps: All cloud apps
Conditions: Exclude trusted locations (HQ, VPN)
Grant: Require MFA + Require compliant device
Mode: Report-only -> review sign-ins -> On
caption: Report-only first proves the policy doesn't block real admins before it ever enforces anything.

caption: The Any-to-Any rule is deleted outright, not narrowed in place -- that's what keeps it from drifting back open.
